newsitem.title: USA: Rural Cellular to form wireless venture.
newsitem.headline: Rural Cellular to form wireless venture.

text.p: Rural Cellular Corp and American Portable Telecom Inc signed a letter of intent to form a joint venture, Rural Cellular said Monday.
The venture, Wireless Alliance LLC, will construct and operate personal communications service networks in Duluth, Minn., Fargo and Grand Forks, N.D., and Superior, Wis.
Subject to a definitive agreement requiring regulatory approvals, Wireless Alliance will be 51 percent-owned by Rural Cellular and 49 percent owned by American Portable Telecom.

Terms provide for Wireless Alliance to use 20 megahertz of American Portable Telecom's 30 MHz broadband spectrum within the Duluth-Superior, Fargo and Grand Forks portions of the company's Minneapolis Major Trading Area License.
The new rural Personal Communications Service is designed for business, residential and mobile applications.
